description: This Java source file defines the BaseRelationService class, implementing relation management logic for entities, including CRUD operations, relation queries, caching, event handling, and recursive relation fetching within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RelationQueueCtx
classes.description: Helper class for managing relation fetch queue and state during recursive relation searches.

methods.name: handleEvictEvent
methods.description: Handles cache eviction when an EntityRelationEvent occurs, evicting related cache entries.

methods.name: checkRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if a relation exists between two entities with specified type and group.

methods.name: checkRelation
methods.description: Synchronously checks if a relation exists between two entities with specified type and group.

methods.name: getRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a relation between two entities, utilizing cache for optimization.

methods.name: saveRelation
methods.description: Saves or updates a relation, evicts cache, and publishes related events.

methods.name: saveRelations
methods.description: Saves multiple relations in batch, evicts cache, and publishes events.

methods.name: saveRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously saves a relation, evicts cache, and publishes events upon completion.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation, evicts cache, and publishes deletion event.

methods.name: deleteRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a relation, evicts cache, and publishes deletion event.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a relation between specified entities, with cache eviction and event publication.

methods.name: deleteRelationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a relation between specified entities, with cache eviction and event publication.

methods.name: deleteEntityRelations
methods.description: Deletes all inbound and outbound relations for an entity, optionally filtered by relation type group.

methods.name: findByFrom
methods.description: Finds all relations originating from a specific entity, with cache optimization.

methods.name: findByFromAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations from a specific entity, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: findInfoByFrom
methods.description: Finds relation info from a specific entity, including entity names.

methods.name: findByFromAndType
methods.description: Finds relations from an entity filtered by relation type and group.

methods.name: findByFromAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations from an entity filtered by relation type and group.

methods.name: findByTo
methods.description: Finds all relations targeting a specific entity, with cache optimization.

methods.name: findByToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations targeting an entity, utilizing cache if available.

methods.name: findInfoByTo
methods.description: Finds relation info to a specific entity, including entity names.

methods.name: findByToAndType
methods.description: Finds relations to an entity filtered by relation type and group.

methods.name: findByToAndTypeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds relations to an entity filtered by relation type and group.

methods.name: findByQuery
methods.description: Performs recursive relation search based on query parameters, with filtering and limit.

methods.name: findInfoByQuery
methods.description: Retrieves relation info based on query, including entity names.

methods.name: removeRelations
methods.description: Removes all relations associated with an entity.

methods.name: findRuleNodeToRuleChainRelations
methods.description: Finds relations from rule nodes to rule chains, filtered by rule chain type.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQueryAsync
methods.description: Executes relation path query asynchronously.

methods.name: findFilteredRelationsByPathQueryAsync
methods.description: Executes filtered relation path query asynchronously with optional relation filter.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQuery
methods.description: Finds relations based on relation path query, with limit.
